  | description = Exchange this token for 1 (Bound to Character) Raid Item from a list. To do this, speak with [[Miina d'Kundarak]] at [[The Anniversary Celebration]]! Items received from this exchange cannot be consumed for Sentient XP.
  | notes       = See the [[20th Anniversary]] page for a list of rewards given in return for this token (a more detailed view can be found at [[20th Anniversary/Freebie alternative view]].)

Items received from this token, as well as not being eligible Sentient Weapon food, cannot be used at the [[Soulforge]] to craft Essence augments. This is due to the unique enchantment {{Gift}} attached to the item when it is given to you. (Certain forms of crafting such as [[Epic Crafting]] or the [[Fountain of Necrotic Might]] ''can'' remove this enchantment!)
:* {{Bug|'''Do not''' claim the Exclusive item {{Item|Void, the Endless Cold}} using this token if you already have a copy in your inventory! You will not recieve another copy of the item and your token will be lost.}}
:* {{Bug|It has been reported that the {{Item|Dull Dagger}} cannot be upgraded correctly if claimed via this token.}}
